title: Accessibility Fare Schedule — RideLink Alternative-Ride Fare Base
content:
The fare base of a Non-Emergency Medical Transportation alternative ride taken after a late pickup reflects the help the member needs to travel.

**Rule.** The fare base follows the help the member needs: a member who holds an approved or expired Durable Medical Equipment Authorization for a standard manual wheelchair, service code K0001, gets the accessible fare base of 12.00 USD; a member without one whose level gives door-to-door or door-through-door driver assistance gets the assisted fare base of 6.50 USD; any other member gets the standard fare base of 3.50 USD.

The wheelchair authorization is read from the member's Prior Authorization records — the Durable Medical Equipment Authorization class, service code K0001, in approved or expired status. The driver assistance is the one the member's RideLink level gives: door to door on RideLink Door-to-Door Assist and RideLink Wheelchair Van, door through door on RideLink Stretcher Van.

## Fare base, tested in order

| Test | Fare base |
|---|---|
| Approved or expired K0001 wheelchair authorization on record | 12.00 USD |
| Otherwise: the level gives door-to-door or door-through-door assistance | 6.50 USD |
| Otherwise | 3.50 USD |

## Cases

*Hypothetical members:*

- RideLink Ambulatory Sedan, expired K0001 wheelchair authorization: 12.00 USD.
- RideLink Door-to-Door Assist, no wheelchair authorization: 6.50 USD.
- RideLink Ambulatory Sedan (curb to curb), no wheelchair authorization: 3.50 USD.
- RideLink Stretcher Van, a K0001 authorization in denied status: not approved or expired, so the level's door-through-door assistance gives 6.50 USD.
